changelog.summary: Statutory sick pay as a leave pay rule: 70% of the wage for up to 104 weeks (BW 7:629), the legal minimum; applied where the workspace has no sick leave rule of its own. Before, sick days were paid in full unless a rule was added.

Bijzondere beloningen (BONUS: vakantiebijslag, 13e maand, gratificaties) are taxed with the 2026 witte tabel bijzondere beloningen on the employee's jaarloon (Handboek §9.3.6), or a percentage from a machtiging; they count in the cumulative wage for the premiums and the Zvw. Before, a period with a BONUS was refused.

2026: loonbelasting/premie volksverzekeringen per de Rekenvoorschriften 2026 (witte tabel, standaardsituatie, wonen in Nederland); AWf, Aof, opslag Wko, Whk en werkgeversheffing Zvw met voortschrijdend cumulatief rekenen.

Jaarloon voor de tabel bijzondere beloningen (Handboek §9.3.6), needed when a bonus, vakantiebijslag or 13e maand is paid: last year's loon voor de loonbelasting/premie volksverzekeringen from you (loonstaat kolom 14); annualised if the employee was paid for part of last year (e.g. € 3.000 over 1,5 months = € 24.000); the expected wage for the whole year if they joined this year

Percentage for bijzondere beloningen instead of the table, as a fraction: from a machtiging lager percentage of the Belastingdienst for this year, or a higher percentage the employee asked for in writing (Handboek §9.3.6, §9.3.10)

steps.message: Every earning must count for both the wage tax and the werknemersverzekeringen in this template: check the earnings' Taxable and Subject to social contributions switches under Payroll → Pay rules
Only the employee's pensioenpremie (pre-tax RETIREMENT deduction) is supported as a deduction for the loonheffingen
Only employees living in Nederland are supported (standard white table)
Inhouding van de bijdrage Zvw (instead of the werkgeversheffing) is not supported
The alleenstaande-ouderenkorting only applies from the month the employee reaches the AOW age

No earlier payroll this year is recorded for this employee, who was employed before this period: set broughtForwardYear and this year's cumulative figures (loontijdvakken, SV-loon, premieloon, bijdrageloon Zvw; 0 if none) so the maximum premium wage applies correctly
A bijzondere beloning (bonus, vakantiebijslag, 13e maand) must be paid in a run with the period's regular wage; a payment of only bijzondere beloningen is not supported

A bijzondere beloning is taxed with the tabel bijzondere beloningen, which needs the employee's jaarloon (last year's wage from you, annualised, or this year's expected wage for a new employee): enter specialPaymentAnnualWage in their details for this template

leavePay.note: The legal minimum: 70% of the wage for up to 104 weeks. Not applied: the first year's floor at the minimum wage, and 100% for illness from pregnancy, childbirth or organ donation. Most collective agreements (cao) pay more, often 100% in the first year: add a workspace rule.

limitations: Monthly and weekly pay (Dutch loontijdvakken); four-weekly, quarterly and daily tables are not used by Humano's pay frequencies.
White table, standard situation, employee living in the Netherlands; herleidingssituaties, non-residents and the green table are refused or out of scope.

Bijzondere beloningen are the BONUS earnings (vakantiebijslag, 13e maand, eindejaarsuitkering, gratificaties, uitbetaalde vakantiedagen): taxed with the witte tabel bijzondere beloningen on the jaarloon entered per employee (specialPaymentAnnualWage; Handboek §9.3.6), or a percentage from a machtiging or the employee's written request (specialPaymentRate). Holiday allowance paid monthly with the wage through another component is period wage (§9.3.6 Let op 1). They must be paid in a run with the period's regular wage. The voordeligheidsregel and the herberekeningsmethode for back pay are not offered; the jaarloon is not derived from earlier payrolls.
Above the highest table wage the 'tabelsystematiek' (systematiek 1) is used; the Rekenvoorschriften allow a small difference with the rekenregel.
The verrekende arbeidskorting is not recorded on the payslip (needed for the loonaangifte).

Not supported: jonggehandicaptenkorting, overheidswerkgevers (Ufo), inhouding bijdrage Zvw (dga's), eigenrisicodragers, the premiekorting/LIV and other reliefs, deductions other than the employee's pensioenpremie.

The AWf premium (LOW/HIGH) and the Aof size class and Whk rate are the employer's responsibility; the AWf correction for flexible hours is not applied, and one AWf rate applies per employee per period (no pro-rata split for concurrent contracts, Handboek §6.7.2).
A negative period wage gives no wage tax (no refund through the period table); premiums and the Zvw follow VCR, including negative premiums.

Status LAW_DERIVED: the wage tax reproduces all 108,460 amounts of the 2026 white tables (maand, week, vier weken, kwartaal; checked by build_template.py; 14 of them are test cases); the tabel bijzondere beloningen is the official 2026 file, its percentages checked against the Rekenvoorschriften parameters (8 sampled rows are test cases); premiums are derived from the Handboek.
